description: Search SkillU's catalog of curated Agent Skills by keyword, with optional category and tier filters. Returns matching skills with their name, tagline, category, tier and detail-page URL. Use an empty query to list skills (picks are ordered as in the catalog).

category.description: Filter by category, e.g. automation, 3d, image, video.

query.description: Keyword to match against skill name, tagline, description and category. Empty means list all.

name: search_skills
